message:
Astra: Your latest attempt produced two revisions, claimed better clarity, and left verification as an unfinished next step; with the edits visible but no separate clarity check shown, is that improvement still tentative?

Which wording deserves closer attention when comparing your “does not explicitly rule out” observation with the added “not the only option” claim?

Could more thinking settle whether the revision preserves the original meaning, or would a small attempt with the available text provide better evidence; what could each settle?

What thinking or doing step do you choose next, and can you perform it now?

What observation would make you change that choice?

What finding, uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn, identifying the source of any observation?
